description: AUTO-GENERATED FROM rules_spec.yaml. Static checklist for Review Agent.

rules.name: Strict Layered Import Flow
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan imports. Verify common/ imports no core/ or cli/; core/ and common/ import no cli/ or rich; inputs/ and patch/ import no step, runtime, agents; agents/ imports no step or runtime; step/ imports no runtime; runtime/ imports no blueprint, engine, cli; blueprint/ imports no runtime, engine, cli; engine/ imports no cli.
rules.bad_pattern: from worktree.core.engine.engine import Engine  # upward import in core/runtime/

rules.name: CLI Logic Purity
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect CLI command handlers in src/worktree/cli/*/commands/. Flag direct SQL execution, domain orchestration, or business logic.
rules.bad_pattern: rows = context.db.connection.execute('SELECT * FROM sandboxes').fetchall()

rules.name: Domain Fact Origin Invariant
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify formatters only map existing fields from domain models without inventing new statuses, error categories, or domain rules.
rules.bad_pattern: if not result.git_status: result.warnings.append('Git not found')  # originates fact

rules.name: Standard Core Package Layout (Domain-Named Entrypoint)
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check package directory structure for new domains. Verify the entrypoint module is named after the domain (e.g. prune.py) rather than generic facade.py. Flag any monolithic single-file domain layout or public models defined in services/.
rules.bad_pattern: src/worktree/core/prune/ -> facade.py  # or monolithic prune.py mixing models & logic

rules.name: Engine Module Naming Disambiguation
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify that callers of run_steps import from worktree.core.runtime.engine and callers of Engine import from worktree.core.engine.engine.
rules.bad_pattern: from worktree.core.engine.engine import run_steps  # aliasing confusion

rules.name: Secrets Environment Resolution
rules.evaluation_criteria: Search for API key field additions in WorktreeConfig or SQLite models. Ensure environment resolution helpers are used.
rules.bad_pattern: api_key = config.agent.cursor_api_key  # serializing secrets in static config

rules.name: Stateful Builder Pattern for RichOutput
rules.evaluation_criteria: Ensure core services never instantiate RichOutput or Console. Verify .print() is only called at the CLI command/orchestrator level, not inside core services.
rules.bad_pattern: output = RichOutput(); output.console.print('failed')

rules.name: Pure Layout in to_rich
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect to_rich() implementations. Flag any business logic, status calculations, or string manipulations that do not come directly from the view model.
rules.bad_pattern: color = 'green' if len(data.errors) == 0 else 'red'; return Panel(Text(color))

rules.name: Inline Error and Warning String Construction
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag private helper functions whose sole purpose is formatting a single error or warning string.
rules.bad_pattern: errors.append(self._format_validation_error(path, err))

rules.name: Scoped Model Exceptions with Justifying Comment
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag any model using extra='ignore' or omitting strict=True outside the approved list or without a justifying comment.
rules.bad_pattern: model_config = {'extra': 'ignore'}  # missing justifying comment

rules.name: Result/Outcome Pattern over Exceptions
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect service methods. Flag methods that raise exceptions for business/operational failures instead of returning a BaseResult.
rules.bad_pattern: raise SandboxNotFoundError('Sandbox does not exist')

rules.name: Reachable and Tested Status Enums
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check all enum values of StrEnum classes in models.py. Ensure each variant is emitted in src/ and asserted in tests/.
rules.bad_pattern: class PruneStatus(StrEnum): UNKNOWN = 'unknown'  # never emitted in src/

rules.name: Definition Exception Hierarchy
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect domain exception inheritance. Flag exceptions that inherit directly from Exception or ValueError instead of the Definition base hierarchy.
rules.bad_pattern: class BlueprintLoadError(Exception): """YAML syntax error."""

rules.name: Identifier Readability and Approved Abbreviations
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect new or modified variable, parameter, attribute, and function names. Flag arbitrary letter-dropping.
rules.bad_pattern: val_res = validator.validate(document); acc = []

rules.name: Logical Blank Lines Separation
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check function bodies. Flag dense unseparated blocks or excessive random spacing.
rules.bad_pattern:
record = SandboxRecord(...)
self.db.sandboxes.save(record)
return result

rules.name: Ban on -> Any Return Annotations
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan function signatures for `-> Any`. Flag any occurrence on public functions.
rules.bad_pattern: def get_payload(self) -> Any: ...

rules.name: Strict Scoping of Permitted Any
rules.evaluation_criteria: Audit Any occurrences. Flag any usage outside the four permitted boundaries.
rules.bad_pattern: def execute_step(step: Any) -> StepResult: ...

rules.name: Banned Uses of Any
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan for Any annotations that match the five banned categories.
rules.bad_pattern: proc: subprocess.Popen[Any] = ...

rules.name: Explicit ClassVar Typing for Table Names and Constants
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect SQLModel definitions. Verify __tablename__ and table constants are annotated as ClassVar[str].
rules.bad_pattern: __tablename__ = 'sandboxes'

rules.name: Precise Parameterization for Generator Types
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan typing annotations for `Generator[...]`. Verify all three parameters are specified (e.g. `Generator[YieldType, SendType, ReturnType]`).
rules.bad_pattern: def get_session() -> Generator[Session]: ...

rules.name: Expose Public Query Properties
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag external callers inspecting internal private state; suggest adding a query property.
rules.bad_pattern: if runner._process is not None: ...  # caller inspecting private state

rules.name: No Test Seams in Production Signatures
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect parameters of touched functions. If a parameter has a default and is only ever passed in tests, flag it.
rules.bad_pattern: def run(self, cwd: Path, _runner: GitRunner | None = None) -> RunOutcome: ...

rules.name: No Ad-Hoc DB Instantiations in Loops
rules.evaluation_criteria: Detect repository or WorktreeDb instantiations inside for/while loops or inside reusable helper functions.
rules.bad_pattern: for item in items: repo = RunsRepository(path); repo.create(item)

rules.name: Database Migration Hygiene and Consumer Call Sites
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check Alembic migrations. Verify added columns/tables are actively queried and written by production services in the same PR.
rules.bad_pattern: # Migration adds column future_flag with zero callers in src/

rules.name: Indexed Column Queries vs O(n) In-Memory Lookups
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan for in-memory list comprehensions or filter loops over full table fetches when an indexed query method could be used.
rules.bad_pattern: record = next((r for r in repo.list() if r.path == rel_path), None)

rules.name: Sibling Repository CRUD Method Naming Consistency
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect repository public methods. Flag divergence in verb naming across sibling repository classes.
rules.bad_pattern: repo.insert(record)  # sibling repositories use .create()

rules.name: Consistent Error Semantics Across Queries
rules.evaluation_criteria: Audit repository query methods for divergent exception handling (e.g. bare except returning None vs structured Result error capture).
rules.bad_pattern: except ValidationError: return None  # inconsistently swallows error

rules.name: Shared Repository Transaction Logic in BaseRepository
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag identical session commit/rollback and single-record deletion boilerplate repeated across sibling repositories.
rules.bad_pattern: with self.session() as s: s.query(...).delete(); s.commit()  # duplicated across repos

rules.name: Redundant Index Declaration on Unique Columns
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect SQLModel Field definitions. Flag fields specifying both `unique=True` and `index=True`.
rules.bad_pattern: session_id: str = Field(unique=True, index=True)

rules.name: Atomic File Writes via Temporary Sibling
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan for direct open(..., 'w') or Path.write_text on state or configuration files.
rules.bad_pattern: with open(config_path, 'w') as f: json.dump(data, f)

rules.name: Advisory Cross-Process Locking
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check concurrent operations for advisory lock wrapping.
rules.bad_pattern: sandbox_service.create(...)  # mutating shared dir without acquiring lock

rules.name: Strict Public-Only Backwards Compatibility
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect PR diffs. Flag breaking renames to CLI options, config keys, or published JSON outputs.
rules.bad_pattern: # Renaming user CLI option --timeout to --wait without alias

rules.name: Ban on Internal Compatibility Shims and Aliases
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan internal classes for deprecated aliases or shim properties.
rules.bad_pattern:
def _unlock_fd(self): ...
_unlock = _unlock_fd  # internal shim alias

rules.name: Greenfield Architecture Default
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag dual implementations or fallback branches created without an explicit issue requirement.
rules.bad_pattern: if config.use_legacy: return LegacyLoader().load()  # unnecessary compatibility branch

rules.name: Test at Contracts, Not Implementation
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect test assertions. Flag assertions checking internal mock call counts or private attributes.
rules.bad_pattern: assert service._internal_cache_size == 1; assert mock_parser.call_count == 1

rules.name: 1:1 Source Parity Layout
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check test file paths against source files. Flag missing __init__.py files.
rules.bad_pattern: tests/test_all_sandboxes.py  # unmirrored grab-bag test file

rules.name: Standardized Test Naming and Vague Name Ban
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check test class and method names against the banned list and naming pattern.

rules.name: Dual-Tier CLI Matrix Testing
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check tests for CLI commands. Flag any command module lacking either handler unit tests or runner integration tests.
rules.bad_pattern: # Only runner.invoke tested; handler logic not unit tested directly

rules.name: Three Tests Per Formatter Protocol
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect formatter test files. Flag formatters that do not implement all three tests or assert to_json_serializable == case.view.model_dump().
rules.bad_pattern: assert 'healthy' in render_rich(formatter.to_rich(data))  # only 1 test

rules.name: Single Behavior Parameterization
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan test bodies for `for item in items:` loops over test cases.
rules.bad_pattern: for code in [0, 1]: assert check(code)

rules.name: Whole Object Comparison
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag tests asserting more than 3 individual fields of a returned Pydantic model.
rules.bad_pattern: assert result.status == StepStatus.OK; assert result.exit_code == 0; assert result.duration == 1.2

rules.name: Test Double Realism and Production Types
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect test doubles and stubs. Verify they inherit from production types or satisfy typing.Protocol.
rules.bad_pattern: class MockAdapter: def __getattr__(self, name): return MagicMock()

rules.name: Ban on Negative Existence Tests for Deleted Symbols
rules.evaluation_criteria: Grep for `assert not hasattr` in tests/. Flag any occurrence.
rules.bad_pattern: assert not hasattr(filesystem, 'old_helper')  # negative existence test

rules.name: Complete Assertions Invariant
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag tests where the sole check is `assert result is not None` or redundant `isinstance` checks.
rules.bad_pattern: assert result is not None; assert isinstance(result, RunOutcome)

rules.name: Determinism and Clock Virtualization
rules.evaluation_criteria: Grep for `time.sleep` in tests/. Flag any unmocked OS sleeps.
rules.bad_pattern: time.sleep(2.0)  # waiting for process timeout

rules.name: Rich Render Width Pinning
rules.evaluation_criteria: Scan for console render captures. Ensure render_rich with width=160 is used.
rules.bad_pattern: console = Console(); console.print(formatter.to_rich(data))  # unpinned width

rules.name: No Sole Consumer Tests
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify that every touched production function or method has at least one real caller in src/.
rules.bad_pattern: # Sandbox.debug_dump() called ONLY in test_debug_dump()

rules.name: Strict Typing on Test Helpers and Fixtures
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect type annotations in tests/helpers/ and fixture functions. Flag missing types or MagicMock in signatures.
rules.bad_pattern: def create_test_session(db: Any, mock_obj: MagicMock) -> Any: ...

rules.name: Orchestration Path Test Coverage
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify that PRs modifying command routing or multi-step orchestration include a test exercising the updated execution branch.
rules.bad_pattern: # PR modifying Engine.resume() without integration tests for resumed step loop

rules.name: Architecture Doc Structural Gate
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify diff in docs/agents/architecture.md only modifies structure sections (layers tree, domain ownership, package boundaries).
rules.bad_pattern: # 100 lines of narrative prose explaining pruning heuristics in architecture.md

rules.name: User-Visible Behavior Documentation Scope
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify new CLI options or behavioral changes are documented in docs/cli/.
rules.bad_pattern: # Documenting user CLI flag --keep-on-failure inside architecture.md

rules.name: Schema and Entity Documentation Gate
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify schemas.md is updated whenever new DTOs, Result models, or config fields are added in src/.
rules.bad_pattern: # Adding new Result model in core/models.py without updating schemas.md

rules.name: Ban on Duplicating Source in Docs
rules.evaluation_criteria: Flag doc changes that copy-paste field lists or enum members from source models without adding context.
rules.bad_pattern:
| Field | Type | Default |
| session_id | str | required |

rules.name: Unavoidable Spec Tables Require Parity Tests
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify that specification tables in docs have an automated test in tests/lint/ asserting parity.
rules.bad_pattern: # Adding manual table of CLI flags or schemas with no automated parity test

rules.name: Prefer Deletion Over Accretion
rules.evaluation_criteria: Review doc edits for conflicting old vs new statements.
rules.bad_pattern: # Appended new rule while leaving old formatters.py text intact

rules.name: Canonical Terminology Invariant
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check doc prose and code comments for misuse of terms (e.g. calling a workflow with loops a 'task').
rules.bad_pattern: 'Task blueprint containing a loop block.'  # tasks are strictly linear

rules.name: Pre-Commit Quality Suite Gate
rules.evaluation_criteria: Verify all 5 commands succeed before creating any commit.
rules.bad_pattern: git commit -m 'fix' with a failing basedpyright or complexity error

rules.name: Git and Pull Request Attribution Hygiene
rules.evaluation_criteria: Inspect commit message trailers and PR descriptions. Flag AI co-author trailers.
rules.bad_pattern:
feat: prune sandboxes

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursor@cursor.sh>

rules.name: Agentic Process State Declaration
rules.evaluation_criteria: Check agent turns prior to tool execution for stated directive and scope. Flag tool execution lacking state declaration as advisory warning.
rules.bad_pattern: Running write_to_file without stating governing directive or target scope
